Yes, all of the Continental Championship promos will be available at a later date in some form. Yes, this means there are cards coming for the Australian and Southeast Asia Championships, as well.

The goal isn't to exclude anyone from getting the cards, but rather to do something nice for the championship events. I don't have a fixed date for when they'll all be available to everyone, but rest assured they'll all be available to everyone.
